# Buffered outside-support concavity, a joint separator, and an actual kink

This is a bounded extension of the buffered response interface, not a
Gamma estimate or a regularity theorem for minimizers. The finite ordinary
facet-constant branch construction is ALREADY proved in
`candidate 07dbcd642c33993d`.
The new points are: the exact curvature of the buffered inverse response,
a joint body/parameter separator for outside-support-only groups with
consistent effective selectors, and a genuine positive-buffer critical
interval group whose response is strictly concave and not linear.

The supporting-facet expansion itself is the audited formula in
`candidate 8d34ae3d0117f855`.
The older `candidate f27caa3ee43c68e2` constructs a robust
generalized-gradient separator on its stated physical cone; it does not
prove convexity of the exact buffered response studied here.

## 1. Exact finite data and the buffered branch fan

Fix actual positive polytope fibers and one actual finite buffered cap
group, with weights rho_j>0, sum rho_j=1, old common mass Q, total mass M,
and beta=Q/M. Every chosen cap has a proper own trace, so its total proper
coarea S_j>0. Write b_j=||u_j|| for its Euclidean continuous normal length;
the cap normal may instead have been normalized in the covariance norm.

Let xi range over a finite-dimensional cone V of ACTUAL, physically
addable signed body and parameter velocities. Inward normal speeds
v_l(xi) are constant on each old supporting facet l, of area A_l. All
speed and total-loss functionals D(xi) are linear. Assume for the moment
that the exact buffered contact budget derivative alpha_i(xi) is linear:
this holds for a singleton contact with the audited energy, covariance,
mass and logarithmic-parameter derivatives all retained. It is an
explicit premise, not a suppression of these terms. Finite fixed contact
sets instead give a minimum of finitely many such linear budgets.

For a threshold increase t r, define B_j as the loss on strict full and
inside-supporting fibers plus the captured proper-boundary loss. The
actual first loss is

    R_j(xi,r)=B_j(xi)+S_j r
       +sum_(l in I_j) A_l (r/b_j-v_l(xi))_+
       -sum_(l in O_j) A_l (-r/b_j-v_l(xi))_+.        (1)

I_j and O_j are INSIDE and OUTSIDE supporting faces respectively. This
formula includes the whole-fiber body loss in B_j on inside fibers. It
is not the closed boundary indicator. It is strictly increasing in r,
with slope between S_j and S_j+sum_support A_l/b_j, and is onto R.

The exact continued common mass has first loss ell_i determined by

    sum_j rho_j R_j(xi,.)^(-1)(ell_i)=alpha_i(xi).     (2)

The normalized improvement is G_i=ell_i-beta D. Positive G_i for every
covering group gives actual strict descent, with the existing fixed-face
cover and off-deepest gap premises. Neither xi nor a facet selector may
be chosen separately for each row of the same deformation.

For completeness the FINITE buffered branch system can be written
explicitly. Choose binary inside signs zeta_jl and outside signs tau_jl.
On their actual sign region put

    L_j^b=B_j-sum_I A_l zeta_jl v_l+sum_O A_l tau_jl v_l,
    S_j^b=S_j+sum_I A_l zeta_jl/b_j+sum_O A_l tau_jl/b_j,
    B_i^b=sum_j rho_j/S_j^b,
    ell_i^b=[alpha_i+sum_j rho_j L_j^b/S_j^b]/B_i^b,
    r_j^b=(ell_i^b-L_j^b)/S_j^b.                     (3)

Impose zeta_jl=1 where r_j^b/b_j-v_l>=0 and zeta_jl=0 where it is <=0;
impose tau_jl=1 where -r_j^b/b_j-v_l>=0 and zero where it is <=0. Ties
can use either branch. These are linear inequalities in xi. The finitely
many resulting polyhedral cones cover all xi and the formulas agree on
their intersections by the unique scalar solution (2). Thus ell_i and
G_i are continuous, positively homogeneous, piecewise-linear functions.
This statement presumes linear budgets; for finitely many contact minima
first split by their minimizing linear branch.

## 2. Curvature of the exact inverse, without selecting facet allocations

If I_j is empty for every cap in the group, R_j is jointly CONCAVE in
(xi,r), since its only nonlinear terms are negatives of positive parts.
Its inverse t_j(xi,q)=R_j(xi,.)^(-1)(q) is jointly CONVEX. Indeed

    r>=t_j(xi,q)  iff  R_j(xi,r)>=q,

and the right side is a convex hypograph constraint. Hence

    ell<=ell_i(xi)
       iff sum_j rho_j t_j(xi,ell)<=alpha_i(xi)       (4)

is convex when alpha_i is linear or concave. Therefore ell_i, and G_i,
are CONCAVE. In particular finite contact minima preserve this conclusion.
This argument uses the exact outside branches, not a worst selector
inserted before solving the threshold equations.

Conversely, if all O_j are empty, R_j is jointly convex, its inverse is
jointly concave, and (2) gives a CONVEX ell_i when alpha_i is linear.
The curvature assertion in this paragraph is analytic: it does not claim
that every arbitrary choice of these finite data occurs in a deepest
critical menu. With both kinds of supporting face there is no curvature
conclusion from (1) alone.

For a specified polyhedral physical cone the exact curvature is decidable
from (3). Work in its linear span and retain the full-relative-dimensional
branch regions. Concavity holds exactly when every such branch linear
form majorizes the realized function on every other region; convexity
uses minorization. Each condition is a finite linear inequality on a
polyhedral cone and can be checked by linear programming. Lower-dimensional
tie regions need no arbitrary choice of an extending branch gradient.

## 3. One joint separator and consistent effective outside selectors

Suppose every group has only outside supporting coincidences, and all
budgets are singleton-linear. Suppose also that there is no actual xi in
V for which every G_i(xi)>0. The downward response set

    {g: there exists xi in V with g_i<=G_i(xi) for all i}

is a convex cone, by Section 2. Separating it from the open positive
orthant gives eta_i>=0, sum eta_i=1, such that

    sum_i eta_i G_i(xi)<=0 for every xi in V.          (5)

Closedness is unnecessary. This is ONE separator for the same combined
physical and parameter cone.

There is moreover a single linear dual retaining consistent coareas and
selectors. A finite concave piecewise-linear G_i is the minimum of its
full-dimensional branch linear forms g_ib. Consequently the sum in (5)
is the minimum of finitely many linear forms. Their convex hull intersects
the negative polar of V: otherwise strict separation of this compact
convex hull from the closed polar gives a vector in the closure of V on
which every form is positive. Continuity and approximation by V then
contradict (5). Thus there are weights lambda_ib>=0 with
sum_b lambda_ib=eta_i such that

    sum_ib lambda_ib g_ib(xi)<=0 for all xi in V.      (6)

No branch need be physically active for EVERY direction. These weights
are a dual convex mixture of genuine branch gradients; no face mass and
moment are independently prescribed.

To check that (6) has exactly the required allocation structure, fix a
group with eta_i>0 and define

    theta_jb=(rho_j/S_j^b)/B_i^b,
    w_ij=sum_b lambda_ib theta_jb,
    kappa_i=sum_b lambda_ib/B_i^b,
    tau_jl^eff=[sum_b lambda_ib theta_jb tau_jlb]/w_ij.

All w_ij are positive. Set

    T_ij=S_j+sum_(l in O_j) A_l tau_jl^eff/b_j.

Then EXACTLY

    w_ij T_ij=kappa_i rho_j,
    sum_j w_ij=eta_i,
    B_i^eff=sum_j rho_j/T_ij=eta_i/kappa_i,
    theta_ij^eff=w_ij/eta_i
       =(rho_j/T_ij)/B_i^eff.                        (7)

The body loss is the corresponding outside allocated trace; its section
coefficient uses the SAME tau^eff. The coefficient of alpha_i is
kappa_i=eta_i/B_i^eff. Therefore the source buffer coefficient is exactly
delta_i^eff=epsilon f_i/B_i^eff, with every mass, covariance, energy and
parameter term in alpha_i multiplied by that same factor. This gives the
same-eta regular dual algebra with a consistent effective outside trace.
It does not produce uniform section measures or identify the surface and
volume transports. Positive coarea S_j keeps all denominators positive.

For multiple contact marks, splitting the minimum budgets introduces
additional contact indices into the dual, as in the existing finite
contact interface; the singleton physical-density formulation above is
not asserted without that bookkeeping.

## 4. Inside faces retain an existential finite branch choice

Fix binary inside choices zeta, replacing each inside positive part by
its selected linear branch. Call the resulting function R_j^zeta. Then

    R_j^zeta<=R_j,

and R_j^zeta is jointly concave because only the outside negative hinges
remain. Its common loss ell_i^zeta therefore is concave and satisfies
ell_i^zeta<=ell_i. It is a valid sufficient response. Conversely, at the
ACTUAL threshold solution (2), choose zeta from its inside signs. All
selected branches agree there, so uniqueness gives ell_i^zeta=ell_i.
Consequently

    ell_i(xi)=max_(binary zeta) ell_i^zeta(xi).        (8)

Thus exact simultaneous improvement is a finite union over inside choices
of the convex outside-only problems. Each chosen tuple has a separator
as above if it has no improvement, but the separators may depend on that
tuple. Equation (8) does not supply one common separator over all inside
choices. This is the buffered extension of the archived ordinary
existential-inside/universal-outside alternative, not a proof that its
quantifiers can be interchanged.

In particular ONE conservative common separator is available for any
mixed-status group by prescribing zeta=0 everywhere. The outside-only
restriction is needed for identifying this concave lower response with
the EXACT response, not for this conservative necessary condition at a
minimum. Co-moving normals are needed if the resulting dual is to retain
the full affine invariances; Section 7 supplies that extension.

## 5. An actual positive-buffer critical group with a strict response kink

Take n=d=1, P={-1,0,1}, and every K_z=[-1,1]. Put L=1, M=6,
Sigma=1/3, and use the actual invariant buffer

    f(z,y)=sqrt(E_(K_z)(y)/M),
    Gamma(u)=sqrt(Sigma) |u|,
    delta=epsilon/3,          0<delta<1/2.

At Y=(0,0), E=2 and the physical threshold displacement is delta. For
arbitrary base tilt and either continuous orientation, the own interval
contributes 1+delta and the two reflected endpoint intervals contribute
at least 2. The latter follows from the uniform reflection pairing at
opposite thresholds of average -delta. Sufficiently steep finite tilts
attain equality. Pure-base depth at zero is 4. Thus the actual buffered
depth is Q=3+delta, and it is a strict-base-gap source.

Endpoint bases have pure-base depth at most 2<Q. On the middle fiber the
physical buffer at y is delta(y)=delta sqrt(1-y^2). Use two steep critical
normals with opposite continuous components. Their exact upper Q
quantiles imply y-delta(y)<=-delta and -y-delta(y)<=-delta at any mark
of depth at least Q. Adding gives delta(y)>=delta, forcing y=0. This
proves that Y is the UNIQUE global buffered deepest point, not merely a
minimum in a sampled normal menu.

Select the actual critical caps

    H_+={x+(1+delta)z>=-delta},
    H_-={-x+4z>=-delta},              rho_+=rho_-=1/2. (9)

H_+ has an outside supporting point at the upper endpoint of fiber -1;
fiber +1 is strict full. H_- has strict empty/full endpoint fibers.
Both have proper own coarea one. Their averaged continuous normal is
zero, and their own-source weighted threshold is the correct buffered
contact. Scaling both normals to Gamma=1 changes no equation below;
we use |u|=1 and physical threshold units for simpler constants.

Now take the exact compatible two-sided radius paths

    r_-(t)=1-h t,  r_0(t)=1-h t/2,  r_+(t)=1,
    K_z(t)=[-r_z(t),r_z(t)].                         (10)

For each fixed signed h these are positive for sufficiently small t>0,
and midpoint compatibility is equality. They form a genuine additive
linear velocity space, not formal independent endpoint changes. Their
mass is M_t=6-3h t, so D=3h. The source energy is E_t(0)=2-h t, hence
E_t(0)/M_t=1/3 EXACTLY. Also

    Sigma_t=[r_-^3+r_0^3+r_+^3]/[3(r_-+r_0+r_+)],
    Sigma'_0=-h/3,
    delta'_0=-delta h/2.                             (11)

The current contact minimum stays at the centered mark, since the source
energy is maximized there. Its exact budget is alpha(t)=delta-delta_t;
therefore alpha'=delta h/2. This retains the mass and covariance change;
holding delta fixed would be the wrong invariant response.

The two actual threshold loss functions are

    R_+(r)=h/2+r-(-r-h)_+,
    R_-(r)=h/2+r.                                    (12)

Equation (2) is (r_++r_-)/2=delta h/2. Solving gives

    ell(h)=(1+delta)h/2             for h>=0,
    ell(h)=(5+4delta)h/6            for h<=0.          (13)

The first branch has r_+>=-h, the second r_+<=-h, so the chosen signs
are the actual ones. The normalized improvement is

    G(h)=-h                         for h>=0,
    G(h)=(delta-4)h/6              for h<=0.           (14)

In particular

    ell(0)-[ell(1)+ell(-1)]/2=(2+delta)/12>0.         (15)

The exact response is strictly concave across zero and is neither convex
nor linear. This is a genuine globally critical POSITIVE-buffer example,
with the same actual compatible path and all normalizations retained.
It does not refute the outside-only concavity theorem; it shows why the
response itself cannot be replaced by an additive physical response
vector. Its convex hypograph is the correct separator object.

The continued group is an actual covering upper bound; it need not stay
the globally optimal menu after perturbation. No equality with the new
global depth is asserted in (13). The example is safely above the OC
threshold and is not claimed to be a joint minimum.

## 6. What this does and does not close

Outside supporting coincidences alone do not obstruct the existence of
one joint singleton body/parameter dual with consistent effective traces.
Exact mixed-status improvement still has the finite choice (8); a fixed
inside choice nevertheless supplies a conservative necessary dual, as
made precise next. No actual inside-support nonconcavity counter at a
positive buffered minimum is inferred from formal hinge data. Nor are
nonconstant facet speeds silently discretized. The checker
`../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_buffered_outside_support_concavity_defect_transport.py` verifies
the exact actual interval clipping, normalization and branch identities;
it passes 4,589 exact checks for Sections 1--6.

## 7. Co-moving normals: a conservative nonregular singleton dual

This section includes a refinement suggested by the contributor after the preceding
outside-only proof. Its conclusion is conditional on an attained minimum,
an actual addable joint body/parameter velocity cone, and finite covering
groups with SINGLETON old contact minima. It does not deduce those
geometric hypotheses from cap nonregularity. The supporting other-fiber
facets may be arbitrary; their actual areas and moments are retained.

Allow each cap normal N_j=(a_j,u_j) to change by t nu_j, with threshold
c_j+t r_j, keeping the old u_j nonzero. Write w=(z,X). On the old cap
plane its margin speed is nu_j.w-r_j. The extension of (1) is

    R_j(xi,nu_j,r_j)=B_j(xi)+S_j r_j-m_j.nu_j
      +integral_(inside) [(r_j-nu_j.w)/b_j-v(w)]_+ dS
      -integral_(outside) [(nu_j.w-r_j)/b_j-v(w)]_+ dS,
    m_j=integral_(proper sections) w dS/b_j.           (16)

This follows from the same radial strip calculation: replace the uniform
threshold speed by its affine value r_j-nu_j.w. The bounded radial and
cap-parameter hypotheses give the same uniform remainder on compact
parameter sets. A rotating plane need not have constant margin on a
facet, so (16) is not claimed piecewise linear with finitely many pieces.

Drop the NONNEGATIVE inside hinge, retaining its whole-fiber body term
in B_j. Denote the resulting lower loss by R_j^0. It is jointly concave
in all displayed variables, strictly increasing in r_j with lower slope
S_j, and satisfies R_j^0<=R_j. Its common loss ell_i^0 is therefore a
concave lower bound for the actual continued loss.

Here is the precise changing-normal contact budget. Normalize the old
Gamma(u_j)=1, and let Y_i be the unique old contact of the group. Put
A_i(t)=sum_j rho_j Gamma_t(u_j+t u'_j). With the old weighted threshold
h_i=sum rho_j c_j, use the EXACT minimum

    alpha_i(t)=min_(current assigned fiber)
        [sum_j rho_j (N_j+t nu_j).w-h_i
                                  -epsilon A_i(t) f_t(w)].

The existing uniform source expansion and uniqueness of the contact give

    alpha_i'=sum_j rho_j nu_j.Y_i
       -epsilon f_i sum_j rho_j grad Gamma(u_j).u'_j
       +alpha_i,body+parameter'.                    (17)

The last term includes the change of the covariance norm at fixed u_j,
the actual mass normalization, source energy, and full-space parameter.
It is the original fixed-normal singleton budget. Thus (17) is LINEAR
on the joint velocity space. Raising the weighted common quantile by
this exact minimum preserves the assigned buffered cover. The finite
off-assignment gaps persist under these small cap changes. Therefore
positive conservative normalized improvements in every group would be
an actual descent, and at a minimum they are impossible.

The supporting selectors in the resulting common dual are consistent.
Indeed, for each outside supporting face choose a Borel tau_j in [0,1].
The identity -s_+=min_(0<=tau<=1)(-tau s) writes R_j^0 as the infimum of

    L_j^tau(xi)+T_j^tau r_j-m_j^tau.nu_j,
    L_j^tau=B_j+integral_outside tau_j v dS,
    T_j^tau=S_j+integral_outside tau_j dS/b_j,
    m_j^tau=m_j+integral_outside tau_j w dS/b_j.        (18)

The moment images of these selectors are compact and convex by weak-star
compactness; only finitely many speed, normal and threshold coordinates
are in use. All T_j^tau>=S_j>0. Equalizing a fixed tuple in (18) gives
one linear loss functional. The exact conservative loss is the infimum
of this compact set of linear functionals: every tuple majorizes it,
and the actual pointwise signs at its solved thresholds attain equality.

The hypograph separation in Section 3 now applies with compact gradient
sets instead of finitely many branches. Compact finite-dimensional
separation and Caratheodory give a finite convex mixture if desired.
The aggregation calculation (7) continues to hold, now also for the
section MOMENTS m_j^tau. Thus one obtains eta_i>=0, sum eta_i=1, one
effective outside density tau_ij^eff, and coareas T_ij>0 satisfying

    B_i^eff=sum_j rho_j/T_ij,
    theta_ij=(rho_j/T_ij)/B_i^eff,
    kappa_i=eta_i/B_i^eff.                            (19)

On inside faces the effective BODY selector is one and the SECTION
selector is zero. On outside faces both are tau_ij^eff. Proper sections
have their full coarea. These prescriptions are forced by the selected
conservative branch and its common dual, rather than chosen separately
in the body and section equations.

The cap-normal coordinates nu_j are independent signed variables.
Comparing their coefficient in (17)--(19), for every eta_i>0 and every
cap j in that group gives the exact allocated section mean

    bar z_ij=p_i,
    bar X_ij=y_i-epsilon f_i grad Gamma(u_ij).         (20)

In detail the coefficient is kappa_i rho_j times
nu_j.(Y_i-bar w_ij)-epsilon f_i grad Gamma(u_j).u'_j;
it must vanish because both signs of nu_j are allowed. This is the
regular section-centroid formula with the SAME outside allocation that
enters the body response. It is a genuine joint physical/parameter dual
under the stated singleton hypotheses, even when other fibers have
supporting facet coincidences. No uniformity of the allocated section
measure, or identity with a volume coupling, follows from (20).

Finally this relaxation has no artificial loss on common fiber-affine
motions when the planes move with them. Let X move with velocity
V_z(X)=A X+Bz+c, and pull the cap planes along the same affine maps:

    u'_j=-A^T u_j,  a'_j=-B^T u_j,  r_j=u_j.c.

The old-plane margin speed is -u_j.V_z(X). With inward body speed
v=-n.V, an inside face has n=-u_j/b_j and

    (r_j-nu_j.w)/b_j=v;

an outside face has n=u_j/b_j and

    (nu_j.w-r_j)/b_j=v.

EVERY supporting hinge in (16) is therefore zero pointwise. All allocated
versions agree with the actual transported cap, whose mass and total
mass change by the same determinant factor. Pulling the parameter along
also preserves its geometric normalization; E/M and the paired covariance
norm transform exactly as in the invariant-buffer theorem. Hence the
normalized improvement is zero for both signs of the common affine
motion. Fixed-normal relaxation alone would not justify this nullity.

This last assertion uses the EXACT transported parameter, not a presumed
continuous parameter jet -grad L.V. For finite-PL L that formal jet can
jump at a moving crease and need not exist uniformly. Compose an actual
admissible body/parameter/cap path with the common affine map instead;
exact invariance leaves its normalized covering response unchanged. This
adds affine null directions at the actual response level without inserting
an inadmissible uniform parameter derivative. No positive-source gradient
uniqueness is used before the volume martingale has proved it.

This section removes the other-fiber supporting regularity requirement
from the singleton conservative dual. It does not prove singleton
contacts, choose a universal dual simultaneously for every inside branch,
differentiate reoptimized parameters, or prove any numerical payment.
